about_title: Horizontal presses with a tool for every bend
about_text: Tubend designs and builds bending and forming machinery in Bursa, Turkey. Its HP horizontal presses bend, punch, shear, notch and straighten flat bar, pipe, solid bar and busbar with the part lying flat on the table — NC-controlled from 11 to 165 US tons, with a touch-screen recipe control, an optional servo back gauge and an extensive library of bending, punching, shearing, pipe and busbar tools. The TB 34 and TB 42 are simple mandrel-less pipe benders, and the WP 100 and WP 300 tilting welding positioners turn round parts under the torch.

NovoTech sells, installs and supports Tubend machines in Canada from Mississauga, Ontario — tooling chosen for your parts, installation, operator training, a CSA-approved panel on three-phase machines, a 1-year warranty and parts and technical support in Canada.
made_in: Made in Turkey by Tubend — with European components
